Question B-001-015-004.

Why the correct answer is right: The bank states that certificate holders may operate radio-controlled models on all amateur bands above 30 MHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "if the control transmitter does not exceed 15 kHz of occupied bandwidth": This invents a bandwidth condition instead of using the above-30-MHz band boundary for model control.
- sourceIndex 2: "on all amateur radio bands below 30 MHz": Below-30-MHz bands are the opposite side of the boundary taught for model-control operation.
- sourceIndex 3: "if only pulse modulation is used": The bank's model-control permission is not limited to a pulse-modulation condition.
